args.sql:
SELECT AVG(T1.reliabilityindex) AS avg_reliability
FROM equipment AS T1
JOIN cabinenvironment AS T2 ON T1.equipmentcode = T2.cabineqref
WHERE T2.cabinclimate->>'temperature_c' BETWEEN '20' AND '25'
AND T2.cabinclimate->>'humidity_percent' BETWEEN '30' AND '50'
AND T2.cabinclimate->>'air_quality_index' < '200'
AND T2.cabinclimate->>'pressure_kpa' BETWEEN '950' AND '1050'
AND T2.cabinclimate->>'o2_percent' > '15'
AND T2.cabinclimate->>'co2_ppm' < '1000';

SELECT AVG(T1.reliabilityindex) AS avg_reliability
FROM equipment AS T1
JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid AS T2 ON T1.equipmentcode = T2.thermaleqref
WHERE T2.renewablemetrics->>'temperature_c' BETWEEN '20' AND '25'
AND T2.renewablemetrics->>'humidity_percent' BETWEEN '30' AND '50'
AND T2.renewablemetrics->>'air_quality_index' < '200'
AND T2.renewablemetrics->>'pressure_kpa' BETWEEN '950' AND '1050'
AND T2.renewablemetrics->>'o2_percent' > '15'
AND T2.renewablemetrics->>'co2_ppm' < '1000';
